senses.definition: To make something not dirty; to remove dirt, dust, or stains from an object or surface.

examples.text: मैं अपनी मेज़ साफ़ कर रहा हूँ।
examples.emotion: focused and steady, busy with a routine chore

senses.definition: To remove clutter or clear a space so that it is empty and ready to use.

examples.text: खाने के बाद उसने थाली साफ़ की।
examples.translation: After eating, she cleared her plate.
examples.emotion: quietly finishing up after a meal

faults.quote: खाने के बाद उसने थाली साफ़ की।
faults.why: थाली साफ़ करना means either washing a plate or eating everything on it, not clearing clutter.
Cleaning a surface and tidying a room are one everyday sense of साफ़ करना.
